fusions.name: Waiting Jaws
fusions.desc: Snaps shut on a weakened enemy for 20 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the bite, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps on and rolls the target across stinging coral: the roll deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sink Below
fusions.desc: Sinks you among the coral heads: for 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Motionless Hours
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
